name: cedar elm
where: Everywhere on the lake's clay; banks, yards, creek mouths.
form: An upright vase of fine, slightly drooping branches; corky wings on young twigs.

leaf.look: Small, rough (sandpapery), doubly toothed, dark green.

winter.look: Bare (the game's winter fade); yellow in late autumn (LeafSet007 for the autumn slice later).

bands.hero_0_30m: full model: leaves at true size, the species' bark, roots and low limbs
bands.near_30_150m: same model; the masked shell carries the crown's inside
bands.mid_150_600m: the _Far opaque crown (unchanged band rules: docs/graphics-6, docs/ultra-far-shore)

budget.frame_ms_note: Track D's share of the shore budget (plan: shore Ultra 4.5 / High 3.0 / Medium 1.5 ms) is set at the Mac gate; offline it is held to the depth-pass layer count of today's trees (metrics.csv 'layers').
